name: TukiFlow Direct Checkout for WooCommerce
author: tukiDevs

sections.description:
TukiFlow adds a Buy Now path on top of WooCommerce. A shopper clicks a TukiFlow Buy Now button, or opens a TukiFlow checkout page built for a campaign, and TukiFlow prepares the WooCommerce cart and sends them straight to checkout. Payment, shipping, tax calculation, and order creation stay with WooCommerce at every step.

Key Features

  • Buy Now button on single product pages and on shop/archive product cards
  • Optional sticky Buy Now bar on phones only, or on phones and computers
  • Choice of button placement: before or after Add to cart
  • Global and per-product button text
  • Option to keep the current cart or clear it first when Buy Now is used
  • Option to hide Add to cart globally or for individual products
  • Per-product controls to disable Buy Now, disable Add to cart, or set a default quantity
  • Button design in the Customizer, with a live preview and separate settings for product pages and shop pages
  • Checkout landing pages with an optional coupon applied automatically
  • Page-editor metabox for building checkout landing pages
  • Direct checkout shortcode for single-product pages
  • Home screen with a setup checklist and suggestions for your store
  • Buy Now works with both the classic checkout and the Checkout block; landing pages use the classic checkout form
  • Works with any WooCommerce payment gateway and with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Landing pages and shortcode checkout pages are kept out of page caches, so every shopper gets their own cart
  • Buy Now scripts load only on pages where a button can appear
  • Option to keep or remove TukiFlow data when the plugin is deleted
  • Translation ready

Buy Now Buttons

  • Enable a Buy Now button on single product pages
  • Enable a Buy Now button on shop and archive product cards
  • Place the single-product button before or after Add to cart
  • Set a global label for the Buy Now button, with a per-product override available
  • Inherit the theme’s WooCommerce button styling by default
  • Redirect to native WooCommerce checkout after the item is added
  • Respect the variation selected on the product page before redirecting
  • Respect the quantity entered on the product page before redirecting
  • Run WooCommerce add-to-cart validation before changing the cart

Sticky Buy Now

Keep the Buy Now action available after a shopper scrolls past the product form on a single-product page.

  • Show it on phones only, or on phones and computers
  • Uses the current product quantity and selected variation
  • Shows the product name and a compact price summary in a floating bar
  • Inherits the product’s Buy Now text and single-product button styling
  • Hides again when the original Buy Now button returns to view

Cart Behavior

  • Keep the current cart contents when Buy Now is clicked
  • Or clear the cart first, then add only the selected product

This lets a store run a fast-checkout flow that keeps existing cart items, or a single-offer flow that checks out one product at a time.

Add to cart visibility

  • Hide Add to cart globally, anywhere a TukiFlow Buy Now button is shown
  • Hide Add to cart for one product only, from the product editor

Product-Level Settings

Set from the WooCommerce product editor, on a per-product basis:

  • Disable the Buy Now button for that product
  • Disable Add to cart on that product’s single-product page
  • Set a default quantity for that product
  • Override the global Buy Now button text

These settings apply on top of the global setup, so campaign products can behave differently from the rest of the catalog without changing store-wide settings.

Button Styling

Buy Now buttons match your theme’s buttons by default. To design them yourself, open Appearance > Customize > Buy Now (or the links on the TukiFlow Buy Now screen) and watch the button change on your real store pages.

  • Separate settings for product pages and shop pages
  • Style presets
  • Background, text and border colors, each with a hover color
  • Border width, corner radius per corner, padding per side
  • Font size and weight, width, and the space next to Add to cart

Landing Pages

TukiFlow includes two ways to build a single-product checkout landing page.

Admin Create Flow (TukiFlow > Landing pages > Create landing page)

  • Search for one WooCommerce product, with its thumbnail and pricing shown during selection
  • Set a default quantity for the selected product
  • Set the page title and address, and optionally pick a coupon to apply automatically
  • New pages start with the product photo and description above the checkout, ready for your own pitch
  • Open the created draft directly in the WordPress editor

Landing Pages List

  • Search and filter by published or not published
  • Edit, view, copy the link, duplicate, or move a page to the trash
  • Pages that use the [tukiflow] shortcode are listed too

Page Editor Metabox Flow

  • Enable TukiFlow checkout on any WordPress page from the page editor sidebar
  • Select one product in the page-level metabox
  • Set the selected product quantity and an optional coupon
  • Turning checkout on adds the [tukiflow] checkout block if the page doesn’t have it; move it to where checkout should appear

Landing pages rebuild the WooCommerce cart when the page loads, then render checkout through the standard WooCommerce checkout output. They tell page caching plugins not to cache them, because each shopper needs their own cart.

Shortcode Checkout

On a landing page, [tukiflow] only marks where checkout appears. The product, quantity and coupon are set in the page’s TukiFlow box.

To put a quick checkout on a page without setting it up as a landing page, name the product in the shortcode:

[tukiflow product_id="123"]

An optional quantity attribute:

[tukiflow product_id="123" quantity="2"]

Shortcode-only pages have no coupon. To add one later, turn on “Enable checkout on this page”: TukiFlow keeps the product from the shortcode.

WooCommerce Compatibility

TukiFlow prepares the cart, then hands off to WooCommerce for the rest:

  • Native WooCommerce checkout fields
  • WooCommerce payment gateways
  • WooCommerce shipping and tax calculation
  • WooCommerce order creation
  • WooCommerce order-received and order-pay endpoints
  • Add-to-cart validation from WooCommerce extensions

External services

TukiFlow uses the Freemius SDK (Freemius, Inc.) for an optional opt-in. Nothing is sent unless an administrator clicks “Allow & Continue” on the opt-in screen after activation; choosing “Skip” sends nothing, and TukiFlow works the same either way.

If you opt in, Freemius receives your name and email address, your site URL and title, your WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, your site language, and the list of installed plugins and themes. If you submit the optional feedback form when deactivating TukiFlow, your answer is sent too. You can opt out later from the TukiFlow row on the Plugins screen.

Freemius Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Buy Now buttons, landing pages and checkout run entirely on your own site. TukiFlow sends no shopper or order data to any outside service.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “TukiFlow”, then install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  2. Open TukiFlow > Home. The setup checklist walks you through the first steps.
  3. Buy Now buttons are on by default. Change where they show, the button text and placement, and the cart behavior on TukiFlow > Buy Now.
  4. To change the button’s colors and size, open Appearance > Customize > Buy Now.
  5. Go to TukiFlow > Landing pages to create a checkout landing page.
  6. Open a product in the WooCommerce product editor to set product-level overrides, if needed.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, choose the file, and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin, then follow steps 2-6 above.
sections.faq:
Does TukiFlow replace WooCommerce checkout?

No. TukiFlow prepares the WooCommerce cart and redirects to checkout. Payment, shipping, tax calculation, and order creation are handled by WooCommerce.

Can I use Buy Now without removing Add to cart?

Yes. Add to cart hiding is optional. It can stay visible, be hidden globally wherever Buy Now is shown, or be hidden for individual products only.

Does Buy Now respect product variations and quantity?

Yes. On single product pages, the selected variation and the quantity entered in the quantity field are respected before the shopper is redirected to checkout.

Can different products have different Buy Now settings?

Yes. From the WooCommerce product editor, Buy Now and Add to cart can be disabled per product, and each product can have its own default quantity and button text.

Does clicking Buy Now clear my existing cart?

That depends on the cart behavior setting. A store can keep existing cart contents when Buy Now is clicked, or clear the cart first and add only the selected product.

Where do I configure TukiFlow?

Buy Now and cart behavior are set on TukiFlow > Buy Now, and the button design in the Customizer. Landing pages are managed from TukiFlow > Landing pages, and store-wide options from TukiFlow > Settings.

Does Buy Now match block themes like Twenty Twenty-Three?

Yes. With the default “Match my theme” style, Buy Now uses the same button style as your theme’s other buttons, on classic and block themes. To give it its own look, open Appearance > Customize > Buy Now and choose Custom.

Do I need to exclude landing pages from my cache?

No, not with caching plugins. Landing pages and shortcode checkout pages tell caching plugins not to cache them, because every shopper needs their own cart. If your host caches pages at the server or CDN level, check that it respects these no-cache headers, or exclude the pages there.

How do landing page coupons work?

Pick a WooCommerce coupon when you create the landing page, or in the page editor. TukiFlow applies it when a shopper opens the page, as long as the cart meets the coupon’s rules. If the shopper leaves the landing page, TukiFlow removes the coupon again, so the discount stays with that offer. Coupons the shopper enters themselves are not touched.

Can I sell a variable product on a landing page?

Not as a whole. Pick one specific variation, such as a size and color, when you choose the product. Buy Now buttons on product and shop pages work with variable products as usual.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1 (Nov 6, 2026)

  • New: New landing pages start with the product photo and description above the checkout, and the editor shows a tip for finishing the page.
  • Improved: Pages that use the [tukiflow] shortcode now appear in the Landing pages list and on Home.
  • Improved: Turning on “Enable checkout on this page” adds the checkout block to the page if it’s missing.
  • Improved: New landing pages use a plain [tukiflow] shortcode. The product is set only in the page’s TukiFlow box, so there is one place to change it.
  • Improved: Turning on “Enable checkout on this page” on a page whose shortcode names a product keeps selling that product.
  • Improved: A landing page coupon is removed when the shopper leaves the landing page, so the discount doesn’t carry over to other purchases.
  • Improved: Landing pages added by an import or a site migration show up in the list right away.
  • Improved: US English spelling throughout (“color”).
  • Fixed: With “Match my theme” on block themes such as Twenty Twenty-Three, Buy Now now looks like the theme’s buttons instead of plain text, and lines up with Add to cart.
  • Fixed: On block themes, Buy Now on shop and related product cards sits next to Add to cart instead of on its own row, at the same size.
  • Fixed: With “Match my theme” on themes such as Astra, Buy Now is now the same size as Add to cart.
  • Fixed: On block themes, Buy Now moves under Add to cart in narrow product columns and on phones, instead of being squeezed or cut off.
  • Fixed: New and duplicated landing pages no longer show January 1, 1970 as their date.
  • Fixed: The “Please choose product options” message disappears as soon as the shopper picks a variation.
  • Removed: The Copy shortcode action in the Landing pages list. Use Copy link to share a landing page.

1.3.0 (Nov 2, 2026)

Dashboard

  • New: A fresh, easier TukiFlow dashboard with Home, Landing pages, Buy Now and Settings, plus a menu at the top of every TukiFlow page.
  • New: Home walks you through setup and points out things worth a look in your store.
  • Improved: If you change Buy Now settings in two places at once, TukiFlow asks which version to keep instead of overwriting one.

Buy Now button

  • New: Design the button in Appearance > Customize and see the change on your real store as you edit. Product pages and shop pages can look different.
  • New: Ready-made button styles, plus a “Match my theme” option so Buy Now looks like your theme’s other buttons.
  • New: Choose the space between Buy Now and Add to cart.
  • New: Set the button’s corners and inner spacing separately for each side.
  • Fixed: Custom hover colors no longer show before you hover over the button.
  • Fixed: Buy Now no longer sits right up against Add to cart, and lines up neatly on small screens.
  • Fixed: With newer block themes, Buy Now stays next to Add to cart instead of dropping onto its own line.
  • Fixed: Buy Now buttons under “Related products” on a product page now use your shop page design.
  • Fixed: On phones, the sticky Buy Now bar no longer hides behind Storefront’s bottom bar, and appears even when you jump down the page.

Landing pages

  • New: Find, filter, copy, duplicate and delete your landing pages from one list.
  • Improved: When creating a landing page, the product search shows only products that are live in your store.
  • Fixed: Caching plugins no longer save landing pages, so every shopper sees their own cart.
  • Fixed: A landing page coupon is added back when the cart qualifies for it again.
  • Fixed: The coupon picker no longer shows the coupon code twice.

Other

  • New: Choose whether TukiFlow’s settings are kept or removed when you delete the plugin.
  • Improved: If WooCommerce is turned off, you see one short note with a button to turn it back on, instead of an error on every page.
  • Improved: Updated the built-in Freemius library.
  • Improved: TukiFlow now needs WordPress 6.6 or newer.
  • For developers: New hooks to extend landing pages, the Buy Now button and the TukiFlow dashboard.

1.2.4 (Oct 3, 2026)

  • Fixed: A landing page restored from the trash shows up in the TukiFlow list again.

1.2.3 (Sep 17, 2026)

  • New: Landing pages can add a WooCommerce coupon automatically. Pick it when you create the page or in the page editor.

1.2.2 (Sep 17, 2026)

  • New: An optional sticky Buy Now bar that stays on screen as shoppers scroll, on phones only or on all devices.
  • Improved: Buttons follow your theme’s size and spacing unless you set your own.
  • Improved: New TukiFlow icon in the WordPress menu.

1.2.1 (Sep 15, 2026)

  • Improved: Buy Now only loads on pages where the button can appear.
  • Improved: Landing pages now focus on one product per page.
  • Improved: Smoother updates from older versions, a cleaner uninstall and more text ready for translation.
  • Fixed: Buy Now and checkout pages follow product rules set by WooCommerce and other plugins.
  • Fixed: Add to cart stays visible when a product can’t use Buy Now.
  • Fixed: Buy Now works on cached product pages and tells shoppers clearly when a product can’t be added.

1.2.0 (Jul 10, 2026)

  • New: Checkout landing pages that use the normal WooCommerce checkout.
  • New: A Landing pages screen to create and manage them.
  • New: Per-product settings for Buy Now, Add to cart, default quantity and button text.
  • New: Separate button styles for product pages and shop pages.
  • Improved: Buy Now works better on product pages, shop pages and product grids.
  • Improved: Works better with your existing WooCommerce payment, shipping and tax setup.
  • Improved: A smaller, lighter plugin.
  • Fixed: Several bugs and stability issues.

1.0.1

  • Improved: New TukiFlow logo and purple brand color in the dashboard.
  • Improved: A branded default look for Buy Now buttons.

1.0.0

  • First release.
